summary: Through road by the river with no parking or pull-off on the south side.
reasons: No parked cars on south kerb
Narrow verge, fence and street trees
Low-lying to 4.1 m by the river

drivers.seclusion: South side backs onto golf course, cleared ground and a park, with apartments 26 to 36 m away near 1190 to 1250 m and houses 20 to 27 m away past 1354 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Two-lane road with centre line; south edge is a strip of grass with trees or a golf fence, no gravel pull-off or tyre tracks, so a van would stand in the lane.
drivers.traffic: Moderate through traffic and cyclists on a road linking the riverside to the suburb.
drivers.convention: Cars park on the north side near the car park at 1050 to 1100 m, not along this kerb.

flags: Low-lying: 4.1 to 12.3 m, mapped waterway 11 m away
Flood-prone ground in the 1170 to 1340 m section
Steep stretch at the north end near 1340 to 1389 m, 41% max
Bus zone sign near the end of the stretch
sun_shade: Mixed: golf-course side open to the sun, street trees give patchy shade.
cannot_judge: Whether the grass strips are firm enough to stop on
